items.title: Nick Polites Interview, 1963-10-08
items.q: I've teamed up with a very fine pianist, probably our best pianist in Australia, Graham Coyle. We've played, we had what we call the Polites Coyle Ragtimers, just as a name of a group, playing only at the jazz convention.

ctx.x: No, I do it off the record. I always have. From the record.

I got it from the old Jolly 1923 Genet I think, recording of Perfect Drag. I think that was it. I just played it over and over and over and over again until I got a melody out of it and got some idea of the chords. What I have done each year at the jazz conventions for quite a few years, I've teamed up with a very fine pianist, probably our best pianist in Australia, Graham Coyle. We've played, we had what we call the Polites Coyle Ragtimers, just as a name of a group, playing only at the jazz convention. And…
I wondered about who some of your favorite musicians were, just in general, any instrument or any approach to jazz. Not necessarily jazz, that's what you like.
